g.text: SignOut fences repository work, then clears the local Firestore cache. Remote documents stay intact.
SessionStores clears navigation and root saved state on sign-out or account change. A caregiver who has joined a circle
starts on Whose care. Notification preferences (US-37) are drawn in the Reminders diagram.
When the role can't be read at startup, AccountCheckScreen offers Retry, or "Use another account" through SignOut.
